[Character — Seamus Finnigan]
Position: In front of his bed, fists clenched
Current State: Angry, confrontational

[Prior turns]
(none — this is the first turn)

Round 1 — Player: "Seamus, forget the argument for a second. Where in this room are you right now? Please tell me exactly, I really need to know."

I’m not buying your wild stories about Voldemort! The Prophet’s got it right, and you’re just—just losing it! I can’t share a room with someone who’s gone bonkers!"
